_comment: Action dispatch for g50t-5849a774, read from source on 15-Sep-2026. Line numbers are anchors checked by scripts/test_dispatch_tables.py.

guards.meaning: level-complete flag set by a previous step: advances the level and dispatches nothing.
loss flag set by a previous step: ends the run and dispatches nothing.

THE important guard. While the actor is mid-animation the submitted action is discarded entirely and the animation is stepped instead; the whole action chain sits in the else at :2793. An action pressed during an animation does nothing at all.
the action budget is incremented for every action except RESET, so RESET is free.

available_actions.note: Declared list agrees with every row of 4f0689d0-7d06-4be7-91ac-31cb9a800b85. No _get_valid_actions override, so there is no per-cell filtering. ACTION6 and ACTION7 have no branch and are not offered.

ACTION1.effect: Moves the controlled sprite one cell up (dy=-1). move() at :2655 aborts silently at :2656 if the destination is blocked, and otherwise appends the offset to the recorded move list and replays stored offsets onto the follower sprites.

ACTION4.effect: Moves the controlled sprite one cell right (dx=1).

ACTION5.effect: Commits the recorded move list: copies it at :2699, and if it is non-empty sets the replay flag at :2701 and runs the construction at :2702. This is the ghost-construction action the plan's boundary_reason value is named for. On an empty move list it does nothing at all - the `if self.areahjypvy:` at :2700 is the whole guard.

branch_conditions.meaning: no moves recorded: ACTION5 is a silent no-op.

unhandled_actions.note: ACTION6, ACTION7 and RESET have no branch in G50t.step. ACTION6 and ACTION7 are not offered. RESET is handled by arcengine, which is not vendored in this repo - the only in-source mention is the budget exemption at :2804.

sibling_builds.reason: g50t-5849a774 is the only g50t build in either replay manifest and the only g50t directory under docs/static/games/src/. The question does not arise. See dispatch/README.md for the cross-game measurement that settles it in general.

notes: The animation guard at :2791 means a recording can contain an action row that changed nothing because it arrived mid-animation. A record must not read such a row as a falsified prediction about the action's effect.
